title: Questions 164-167 refer to the following e-mail.
passage_1:
To:Naomi Fairbrook <n.fairbrook@brightpathdesign.com>
From:Callum Reyes <c.reyes@thelanternroom.com>
Date:August 3
Subject:Booking

Dear Ms. Fairbrook,

I am writing to personally apologize regarding your dinner booking for tonight at the Lantern Room. Unfortunately, we were obliged to shut our dining room today because of an unexpected setback.

Early this morning, the cooling system in our dining room failed without warning and could not be restarted. Since we are in the peak of summer, we are unable to reopen until this matter has been resolved. A repair crew has been contacted, and we trust that the work will be finished quickly.

We understand this is a disappointment. I have arranged a complete refund of your booking deposit, which should show on your card statement within four to six business days. To compensate for this trouble, I have enclosed a certificate for a free main course.

Sincerely,
Callum Reyes
General Manager
